tests.report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: I opened the app, which showed the dialog "Bahn 1 kalibrieren". I clicked "Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt", waited 20 seconds and took a new snapshot. The dialog was titled "Bahn 1 wird kalibriert" and said "Bahn 1 fährt gegen den Prellbock und danach zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt. Bitte warten …". Bahn 1's speed showed 60 (20 cm/s), so it was still moving. The dialog never asked the user to place Bahn 2 on the calibration point.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: I opened the app in tab 1 and again in tab 2. Both showed the dialog "Bahn 2 kalibrieren" with the Start button disabled. In tab 2 I clicked "Bahn 2 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt", waited 20 seconds and took a new snapshot. Tab 2 still showed a calibration dialog, now "Bahn 2 wird kalibriert" ("Bahn 2 fährt gegen den Prellbock und bleibt am Kalibrierpunkt. Bitte warten …"), and Start was still disabled. I then switched to tab 1 without reloading. There the dialog was gone, Bahn 2 was on the track sketch and Start was enabled, so that tab met the expected outcome. When I went back to tab 2 a few seconds later, its dialog was gone and Start was enabled too. So tab 2 finished, but after the 20-second wait rather than within it.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed), forward or backward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: Clicked Stop (badge was 'In Fahrt'), reset routes, gave both trains stops Haltestelle 1 and Haltestelle 2, clicked Start (~16:21:08), badge 'In Fahrt'. Mock console: Bahn 1 at speed 120, history 60 fwd -> 0 -> 120 bwd ... -> 120 fwd -> 0 -> 120 bwd (meets criteria). Bahn 2 at speed 0, history 60 fwd -> 0 -> 110 bwd -> 0 -> 110 bwd -> 0; the 110 entries all come from an earlier session (16:20:03, 16:20:19), before this test. After this test's Start (16:21:07-16:21:27) Bahn 2 got no speed command at all; the app's status panel showed 'Geschwindigkeit 0 (0 cm/s)' for Bahn 2 15 s after Start. So this Start made Bahn 1 drive but not Bahn 2.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: Stopped the trains, reset routes, Bahn 1 stops Haltestelle 1 -> Haltestelle 2 (A, B), Bahn 2 reverse (B -> A), clicked Start. The screenshot right after Start showed the markers apart (Bahn 2 at the left switch, Bahn 1 on the lower siding). The screenshot after the 8-second wait showed both markers at the same spot at the left 'Weiche' on the main loop, with the 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' labels stacked over a single marker position. The trains overlapped; neither waited or moved aside.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Badge read 'In Fahrt', clicked Stop ('Gestoppt'), clicked 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen', set Bahn 1 stops A = Haltestelle 1, B = Haltestelle 2, Bahn 2 stops A, B; clicked Start, badge 'In Fahrt'. Screenshots of the track graphic right after Start and at about 30, 60 and 90 s all showed Bahn 1 and Bahn 2 at the same place (bottom-left 'Weiche' between Haltestelle 4 and Haltestelle 3). Bahn 1 never reached stop A or B; the panel speed stayed '0 (0 cm/s)' while the badge said 'In Fahrt'. No loop over the stops was driven.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: For at least one train the history shows, after entries with its normal speed, a new entry with the low calibration speed, followed later by its normal speed again: the train was recalibrated at the calibration point during operation and then continued driving
Observed failure: Set up routes (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 1, Haltestelle 2; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 1, Haltestelle 2) and clicked Start; the badge switched to 'In Fahrt' but both trains showed speed '0 (0 cm/s)'. In the mock console the 'Applied speed changes' column did not change over about 2 minutes (three wait steps plus a reload): Bahn 1 stayed at 'applied: 40', Bahn 2 at 'applied: 24', both at speed 0; the newest message-log entry (16:26:15) predates the test (~16:29). The app sent no speed commands after Start. The normal -> 60 -> normal pattern in the history (e.g. '120 forward -> 0 -> 60 forward -> 0 -> 120 backward') was already present before this run; no new calibration or resumed driving occurred during the test.
Steps completed before failure: 12
